title: Agent Orchestrator repository was publicly referenced
summary: On 2026-03-09, a message in the Composio thread linked the Agent Orchestrator GitHub repository together with a secondary hf.ru URL. The record establishes a contemporaneous public project reference, but does not verify a release, feature set, or other specific milestone. This history entry is therefore limited to that dated reference.
